---
title: "Random walks"
description-meta: "A random walk on supersingular isogeny graphs: the full graph, the F_p-subgraph, or the quotient by Frobenius."
---

A random walk on a supersingular isogeny graph, starting at a random vertex. The laser shows the step being taken and the trail its recent history. Choose the graph and the prime $p$ above the picture. The **view** menu shows the **full graph**, the **$\mathbb{F}_p$-subgraph** (the subgraph induced on the vertices with $j$-invariant in $\mathbb{F}_p$; the walk is switched off when it is not connected), or the **quotient by Frobenius** (vertices and edges are Frobenius-orbits). Vertices are labelled by $j$-invariants on graphs of up to 60 vertices; hover for the others. The **animation** menu switches to the [growing ball](balls.qmd) or the [spectral law](spectral.qmd), and the eye in the corner links to [exact definitions](about.qmd).

{{< include /_partials/isogeny-widget.qmd >}}

```{=html}
<script type="module" src="../assets/js/isogeny-hero.js"></script>
```

The graph tabs: **2**, **2, 3** and **2, 3, 5** are $G_p(\ell)$ with those isogenies. **2 · Γ₀(5)** and **2, 3 · Γ₀(5)** carry a subgroup of order 5, **2 · Γ₁(5)** a point of order 5 up to sign (a directed graph), and **3 · Γ(2)** a basis of the 2-torsion (the supersingular Legendre invariants). The "?" buttons explain each control.
